meta.title: After converting an RFQ to an auction the vendor bids in the auction before the award
gaps: The library case EDGE-DAUC-032 is used for conversion to auction rather than a dedicated conversion operation
Detailed award breakdown fields per line item are not fully verified

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
The buyer sends the request that converts a round into an auction, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
The invited QA vendor places a complete bid (open, price, submit).
The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer awards the line to a vendor on the proposal with the line item uuid set to “…”.
As the invited QA vendor, read the pricing round and check that “status” equals active; “bid count” is at least 2.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “proposals › status” contains awarded.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: “status” equals active; “bid count” is at least 2; “proposals › status” contains awarded.
